title: Inventory Value for a date before release keeps its saved figures
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919); the Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View', 'Part Library & Inventory → Create & Edit' and 'Part Library & Inventory → Delete' and can see costs and prices.
  • Date {Date-A} (for example 1 October 2026) is before the Part Lifecycle build reached this environment, and the Inventory Value report has saved figures for it.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-IVNET-OLD-01, or any existing part the setup finds) is active and tracked at {Location-A} at a unit cost of {Cost-A} (for example $10.00), and has had bins above zero adding up to {Positive-qty-A} (for example 5) and a bin below zero (for example -2) since before {Date-A}, with no change since.
  • The net of all its bins is {Net-qty-A} (for example 5 + (-2) = 3).
  • {Part-A} existed before the release, so this case cannot create its own part; it changes nothing on {Part-A}.
custom_steps:
1. Open Reports → Inventory Value.
  2. Set the Location filter to {Location-A} only.
  3. Set the as-of date to {Date-A}.
  4. Type the part number of {Part-A} in the report's Search box.
  5. Read the {Part-A} row.
  6. Change the as-of date to today.
  7. Read the {Part-A} row.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 5: For {Date-A}, {Part-A} shows the figures saved before release: Qty {Positive-qty-A} and Total Cost {Positive-qty-A} × {Cost-A} (for example 5.00 and $50.00), the positive bins only, as the report counted them then. The release did not rework that date to the net figure.
  • Step 7: For today, {Part-A} shows Qty {Net-qty-A} and Total Cost {Net-qty-A} × {Cost-A} (for example 3.00 and $30.00): dates from release on count the bin below zero.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; bug SV-10380 (Inventory Value report ignores negative bins and overstates net inventory value; Ready to Fix, updated 9 Oct 2026; ships with this epic per Chris Ward's comments of 24 Sep and 7 Oct 2026), description, reproduction table and acceptance criteria, read 13 Oct 2026 and unchanged on 14 Oct 2026; PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), §2 Accounting (new bullet on saved figures and the count of bins below zero), read 14 Oct 2026; QA lead's set-up answers of 9 Oct 2026 (situation 1: a bin below zero). Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • SV-10380 acceptance criteria: “Inventory Value figures saved for dates before release keep their saved values. Only dates from release on count bins below zero.”
  • SV-10380 acceptance criteria: “Existing historical snapshots captured with positive-only quantities are explicitly addressed; changing the live calculation must not be described as repairing old captured values automatically.”
  • PRD §2 Accounting: “Inventory Value figures already saved for past dates keep their saved values. The count of bins below zero, which ships with this release, applies from release on and does not rework earlier dates.”
  • SV-10380 reproduction table: “+5 and -2 | 5 / $50 | 3 / $30”
